name: Melitracen
summary: Melitracen (brand names Melixeran, Trausabun) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA), for the treatment of depression and anxiety. In addition to single drug preparations, it is also available as Deanxit, marketed by Lundbeck, a combination product containing both melitracen and flupentixol.

uses.text: Melitracen (brand names Melixeran, Trausabun) is a tricyclic antidepressant (TCA), for the treatment of depression and anxiety. The pharmacology of melitracen has not been properly investigated and is largely unknown, but it is likely to act in a similar manner to other TCAs.

summaryZh: 美利曲辛，分子式C21H25N，是一種由Upjohn公司研發的三環類抗抑鬱藥，用於治療重性抑鬱疾患和焦慮。
summaryZhHans: 美利曲辛，分子式C21H25N，是一种由Upjohn公司研发的三环类抗抑郁药，用于治疗重性抑郁疾患和焦虑。

pharmacology.en: Like other tricyclic antidepressants, it is thought to block the reuptake of noradrenaline and serotonin, but its pharmacology has not been properly studied.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他三環抗憂鬱藥一樣，它被認為會阻斷正腎上腺素與血清素的回收，但它的藥理尚未被好好研究。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他三环抗忧郁药一样，它被认为会阻断正肾上腺素与血清素的回收，但它的药理尚未被好好研究。

sideEffects.en: As a tricyclic, it can cause dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, drowsiness and dizziness. Tricyclic antidepressants in overdose can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 作為三環類藥物，它可能引起口乾、便秘、視力模糊、嗜睡與頭暈。三環抗憂鬱藥過量可能造成危險的心律問題與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为三环类药物，它可能引起口干、便秘、视力模糊、嗜睡与头晕。三环抗忧郁药过量可能造成危险的心律问题与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Melitracen is best known as one half of Deanxit, a Lundbeck combination with the antipsychotic flupentixol that is widely sold in parts of Asia.
fact.zh: 美利曲辛最為人知的是作為「黛力新」（Deanxit）的成分之一，這是靈北藥廠把它與抗精神病藥氟哌噻噸組合的藥品，在亞洲部分地區廣泛販售。
fact.zhHans: 美利曲辛最为人知的是作为「黛力新」（Deanxit）的成分之一，这是灵北药厂把它与抗精神病药氟哌噻吨组合的药品，在亚洲部分地区广泛贩售。
